content.rendered:
3 in 1 Data & Charging Cable – Premium Multi Charging Solution

The 3 in 1 Data & Charging Cable (with USB C type port) is a smart, space-saving solution designed for users who need fast charging and seamless data transfer across multiple devices. Built with a premium finish cable and connectors, this cable combines durability, performance, and convenience in a single compact design. Whether you use Android, iPhone, tablets, power banks, or Bluetooth accessories, this cable takes care of your charging and data syncing needs effortlessly.

With a thoughtfully engineered design that supports USB, Type-C, Micro USB, and Lightning connections, this 3 in 1 charging cable eliminates the need to carry multiple cables. Its maximum length of 40 inches ensures comfortable use at home, in the office, or while traveling, without unnecessary clutter.

Easy to Store & Travel-Friendly Design

Designed to be easy to store, this multi charging cable is lightweight, tangle-free, and compact enough to fit into laptop bags, backpacks, or car consoles. The flexible yet strong outer coating ensures long-lasting use while maintaining a neat appearance. If you are looking for a portable charging cable that works with multiple devices, this is an ideal choice.

Premium Finish Cable and Connectors

The premium finish cable and connectors are crafted for enhanced durability and stable performance. Reinforced connector joints help reduce wear and tear from daily plugging and unplugging. The smooth finish not only adds to the cable’s aesthetic appeal but also improves resistance to bending and breakage, making it a reliable fast charging and data cable for everyday use.

Universal Compatibility for Charging & Data Sync

This 3 in 1 data & charging cable supports a wide range of devices, ensuring efficient charging and data transfer. It is compatible with smartphones, tablets, power banks, wireless earphones, Bluetooth speakers, and other USB-enabled devices. Whether you need a USB Type-C cable for modern devices, a Micro USB charging cable for older gadgets, or a Lightning cable for Apple devices, this single cable covers it all. Engineered for stability, the cable delivers consistent power flow and smooth data syncing, helping protect your devices during charging. It is suitable for use with wall chargers, laptops, car chargers, and power banks.

Key Features

  • 3 in 1 Data & Charging Cable with USB, Type-C, Micro USB, and Lightning ports
  • Maximum length: 40 inches for convenient everyday use
  • Easy to store, compact, and travel-friendly design
  • Premium finish cable and connectors for durability and long life
  • Supports fast charging and stable data syncing
  • Universal compatibility with smartphones, tablets, and accessories
  • Ideal for home, office, travel, and car use

Why Choose This 3 in 1 Charging Cable?

Choosing this 3 in 1 data & charging cable means choosing convenience, efficiency, and quality. Instead of managing multiple wires, you get one reliable solution that takes care of your charging and data syncing needs. Its universal port design makes it a perfect replacement cable or backup charging accessory. Ideal for professionals, travelers, and everyday users, this cable delivers excellent performance while maintaining a clean and organized setup. If you are searching for a multi charging cable with USB C type port that combines style, durability, and functionality, this product is designed to meet your expectations. Upgrade your charging experience with a premium 3 in 1 charging cable that offers versatility, reliability, and modern design—all in one compact solution
